auth.title: Enroll posting key
auth.intro: Minimal setup route — your posting key is wrapped with your passphrase and kept in a signing worker. Drafts work without this step.
auth.accountFound: Account @{{username}} found. Paste the posting private key (WIF).
auth.errPassphraseLen: Passphrase must be at least 12 characters.
auth.alreadyEnrolled: An account is already enrolled on this device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.vaultStale: On-chain posting key no longer matches this vault. Publishing is blocked. Wipe the envelope below after you confirm the rotation, then re-enroll.
settings.wipeLabel: Wipe stored key (type {{username}} or @{{username}} to confirm)
settings.notEnrolled: No account enrolled. You can still draft offline.
settings.securityBody: Quill encrypts your posting key on this device with your passphrase. After setup the key is not exposed to the page. Drafts are stored locally unencrypted. If someone steals this device and your passphrase, they can post as you. Rotate your posting key if you suspect compromise — Quill will detect the mismatch and wipe its stored key.
settings.languageHelp: Choose the app language. System follows your browser when Spanish or English is available.
settings.msgWiped: Stored key wiped. Re-enroll to publish again.
settings.themeHelp: Light and dark for everyday writing; Honey and Nocturne for a change of mood.
settings.errWipeConfirm: Type your exact username to confirm wipe.
